targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS child, p.age, c.state, c.start_time, c.last_interaction_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_turns t WHERE t.conversation_id = c.id) AS turns, c.parent_summary FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN child_profiles p ON p.id = c.child_id WHERE c.id = ${conversation_id:singlequote}

panels.title: Timeline — turns interleaved with the background logic (chronological)
panels.description: Each TURN row (child + Buju) is followed in time order by the background events it triggered: the recorder's delta (what changed), topics generated, style/opener selection. This is the single-pane view for analysis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT "time", type, child, buju, background_logic FROM ( SELECT (t.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "time", 'TURN'::text AS type, COALESCE(t.child_message,'') AS child, COALESCE(t.system_message,'') AS buju, ''::text AS background_logic FROM conversation_turns t WHERE t.conversation_id = ${conversation_id:singlequote} UNION ALL SELECT (e.ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "time", e.event AS type, ''::text AS child, ''::text AS buju, CASE e.event WHEN 'story.delta_emitted' THEN 'changed=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'changed','[]') || CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.fields->>'interests_added','[]') NOT IN ('[]','') THEN '   +interests=' || (e.fields->>'interests_added') ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.fields->>'topic_focus','') <> '' THEN '   focus=' || (e.fields->>'topic_focus') ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN e.fields->>'changed' LIKE '%summary%' THEN '   summary="' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'summary','') || '"' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN e.fields->>'changed' LIKE '%scene%' THEN '   scene=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'scene','') ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN e.fields->>'changed' LIKE '%throughline%' THEN '   throughline=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'throughline','') ELSE '' END || '   (' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'dur_ms','?') || 'ms)' WHEN 'emotion.plan' THEN 'mode=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'delivery_mode','') || '  mood=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'sentiment','?') || CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.fields->>'mood_nudge','') <> '' THEN ' (' || (e.fields->>'mood_nudge') || ')' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.fields->>'throughline','') <> '' THEN '   throughline=' || (e.fields->>'throughline') ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.fields->>'character_want','') <> '' THEN '   want=' || (e.fields->>'character_want') ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.fields->>'dramatic_tension','') <> '' THEN '   tension=' || (e.fields->>'dramatic_tension') ELSE '' END WHEN 'story.interests_persisted' THEN 'interests=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'n_interests','0') || '  child/buju=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'n_child_origin','0') || '/' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'n_buju_origin','0') || '  main=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'main_interest','') WHEN 'opener.selected' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(e.fields->>'text',''), 'type=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'opener_type','')) WHEN 'style.selected' THEN 'style=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'codename','') || '   reason=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'reason','') WHEN 'style.turn_summary' THEN 'mode=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'mode','') || '  sentiment=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'sentiment','') || '  words(child/bot)=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'child_words','') || '/' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'bot_words','') WHEN 'style.session_summary' THEN 'score=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'score','') || '  turns=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'total_turns','') || '  sentiment=' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'sentiment','') WHEN 'style.leak' THEN 'LEAK: ' || COALESCE(e.fields->>'matched_term','') ELSE LEFT(e.fields::text, 240) END AS background_logic FROM telemetry_events e WHERE e.conversation_id = ${conversation_id:singlequote} ) x ORDER BY "time" ASC LIMIT 1000

list.name: conversation_id
list.label: Conversation
list.query: SELECT c.id AS "__value", COALESCE(p.name,'?') || '  ·  ' || to_char(c.start_time,'MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  ·  ' || left(c.id,8) AS "__text" FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN child_profiles p ON p.id = c.child_id ORDER BY c.start_time DESC LIMIT 100
